description: This file defines a CKEditor plugin dialog for creating or editing 'anchor' elements within the rich text editor. It sets up the dialog's properties, handling of user input, and element creation or modification related to anchors in the editor content.

classes.name: Object returned by CKEDITOR.dialog.add
classes.description: Defines the properties and behavior of the anchor dialog, including initialization, content, and event handlers for OK and show actions.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Handles the creation or update of the anchor element when the OK button is clicked, including copying attributes, moving children, and managing fake elements in the editor.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Initializes the dialog when shown, determining if an existing anchor is being edited and setting up the dialog's state accordingly.
